label: Common uncaused esse-cause from totality cause, whole to members, no self-causation (inference)
rule: Take an actual cause of the received totality; it causes each received member's esse; if it were received it would cause its own esse; so it is uncaused and distinct from every received bearer
meaning: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one fixed q3a4 profile, constructive. A supplies an actual totality cause (collective sense TOTALITY_CAUSE_1), B makes it a cause of each received member, and no self-causation of esse (b62a64ab) excludes its being received, hence it has no actual esse cause and is a distinct actual cause of every received bearer. Mode of causing, immediacy, time, world and necessity stay unspecified; uniqueness of the uncaused bearer and esse-essence identity are not derived. In controls (2)-(5) the conclusion fails (by closedOfCommon, since CCR fails), and in each one of A, B and no self-causation fails, so each is needed in an exact interpretation.
